v_absu.name: Third singular absolute whose stem may still need palatalising (berid for beirid)

nom_pal.name: Noun or adjective stem with a palatal final consonant (fir, maicc)

nom_uinf.name: Noun or adjective stem with u-infection (fiur, purt)

transforms.name: lenition
transforms.description: Lenited initial consonant: ch, th, ph for c, t, p; ḟ, ṡ and the other dotted letters for f, s, b, c, d, g, m, p, t (a chenn → cenn, a ḟer → fer).

transforms.name: nasalization
transforms.description: Nasalised initial: n- before a vowel, m before b, n before d and g, a doubled l, m, n or r (in n-ech → ech, a mbó → bó, a ndía → día, a ngein → gein).

transforms.name: nasalization
transforms.description: Nasalised initial vowel written with n and no hyphen (nanmae → anmae, nech → ech).

transforms.name: h-prothesis
transforms.description: Prothetic h before a vowel (a hÉrinn → Érinn, hí → í, h-uile → uile).

transforms.name: conjunct particle
transforms.description: A conjunct particle before the verb removed: negative ní, nícon, nád, ná, arna; perfective ro; no; interrogative in; co, dia, ma, cía, ara (ní·beir → ·beir, ro·gab → ·gab).

transforms.name: infixed pronoun
transforms.description: An infixed pronoun removed from the particle or preverb before the dot: nom·charat → no·charat, dom·beir → do·beir, atom·aig → ad·aig, nod·n-ail → no·n-ail.

transforms.name: lenition
transforms.description: Lenited initial of the stressed part of a verbal complex (no·charat → no·carat, do·chuirethar → do·cuirethar).

transforms.name: lenition
transforms.description: Lenited f, which is silent, not written after the dot (fod·era → fod·fera, ro·itir → ro·fitir).

transforms.name: nasalization
transforms.description: Nasalised initial of the stressed part of a verbal complex (nod·n-ail → nod·ail, ara·mberar → ara·berar, forsa·mmitter → forsa·mitter).

transforms.name: present
transforms.description: Present indicative, conjunct (·carat → ·cara, do·berat → do·beir, ·léicet → ·léici).

transforms.name: passive
transforms.description: Passive, conjunct (·carthar → ·cara, do·berar → do·beir).

transforms.name: imperfect
transforms.description: Imperfect or past subjunctive, conjunct (·caratis → ·cara, no·léiced → ·léici).

transforms.name: preterite
transforms.description: Preterite, conjunct (·carsat → ·cara, ro·léicset → ·léici).

transforms.name: future
transforms.description: Future, conjunct (·léicfea → ·léici).

transforms.name: conditional
transforms.description: Conditional, conjunct (·léicfed → ·léici).

transforms.name: subjunctive
transforms.description: Present subjunctive, conjunct (·carae → ·cara, ·léicea → ·léici).

transforms.name: 1st singular
transforms.description: First singular present, conjunct, of a strong verb (as·biur → as·beir, do·biur → do·beir).

transforms.name: deponent
transforms.description: Deponent verb, conjunct: other persons and tenses to the third singular (·labratar → ·labrathar, ·midiur → ·midethar).

transforms.name: preterite
transforms.description: Third singular preterite, conjunct, without ending (·car → ·cara, ·léic → ·léici).

transforms.name: spelling
transforms.description: Spelling of a conjunct third singular: final ch for g (ad·aich → ad·aig).

transforms.name: téit
transforms.description: Third singular of a compound of téit written -téit, -tǽt, -táet, -tóet (dotéit, dotǽt, dotáet → dotét).

transforms.name: palatal stem
transforms.description: Third singular conjunct of a strong verb with its palatal stem (·ber → ·beir, ·gab → ·gaib, ·dleg → ·dlig; as·ber → as·beir).

transforms.name: lenition
transforms.description: Lenited stressed part of a compound verb written without the dot (dochuirethar → docuirethar, focheird → foceird, dothǽt → dotǽt).

transforms.name: compound verb
transforms.description: Compound verb in deuterotonic form: the headword is written without the dot (do·beir → dobeir, du·gní → dogní).

transforms.name: absolute
transforms.description: Simple verb: the third singular conjunct to the absolute form, its headword (·cara → caraid, ·léici → léicid, ·beir → beirid, ·ben → benaid, ·gní → gníid).

transforms.name: 1st singular present
transforms.description: First singular present indicative or subjunctive (caraim → caraid, léiciu → léicid, biru → beirid).

transforms.name: 2nd singular present
transforms.description: Second singular present indicative (carai → caraid, biri → beirid).

transforms.name: 1st plural present
transforms.description: First plural present indicative (carmai → caraid, léicmi → léicid, bermai → beirid).

transforms.name: 2nd plural present
transforms.description: Second plural present indicative (carthae → caraid, léicthe → léicid, beirthe → beirid).

transforms.name: 3rd plural present
transforms.description: Third plural present indicative or subjunctive (carait → caraid, léicit → léicid, berait → beirid).

transforms.name: relative
transforms.description: Third singular relative (caras → caraid, léices → léicid, beres → beirid, gnís → gníid).

transforms.name: relative
transforms.description: First and third plural relative (carmae, cartae → caraid; léicme, léicte → léicid).

transforms.name: passive
transforms.description: Passive present (carthair, carthar, cartair → caraid; léicthir, léictir → léicid; berair → beirid).

transforms.name: preterite
transforms.description: Preterite, absolute (carais, carsait → caraid; léicis, léicsit → léicid).

transforms.name: passive preterite
transforms.description: Passive preterite, absolute (carthae → caraid, léicthe → léicid).

transforms.name: future
transforms.description: f-future, absolute (línfaid → línaid, léicfid, léicfit → léicid).

transforms.name: imperative
transforms.description: Imperative third singular, first and third plural (carad, caram, carat → caraid; léiced, léicem, léicet → léicid).

transforms.name: suffixed pronoun
transforms.description: Third singular with a suffixed pronoun "it, him" (beirthi → beirid, gaibthi → gaibid, bentai → benaid).

transforms.name: deponent
transforms.description: Deponent verb, absolute (labrur, labratair, labrathar → labraithir; midiur, miditir, midethar → midithir; suidigiur → suidigidir).

transforms.name: palatal stem
transforms.description: Third singular absolute of a strong verb with its palatal stem (berid → beirid, gabid → gaibid, dlegid → dligid).

transforms.name: copula
transforms.description: A form of the copula is (am, it, níptar, bid, ropo → is).

transforms.name: substantive verb
transforms.description: A form of the substantive verb attá (·tá, fil, filet, bíid, boí, bia, ·roib → attá).

transforms.name: dative plural
transforms.description: Dative plural or dual (feraib → fer, súilib → súil, airib → aire, bélraib → bélrae).

transforms.name: plural
transforms.description: Nominative or accusative plural (falla → fall, branu → bran, cailli → caille, súili → súil, rechtae → recht).

transforms.name: genitive
transforms.description: Genitive singular (rechto, rechta → recht; fechtae → fecht; imdai → imdae; tíre → tír).

transforms.name: dative
transforms.description: Dative singular of io- and ia-stems (cailliu → caille, éscu → éscae, airdiu → airde).

transforms.name: n-stem
transforms.description: Oblique cases of n-stems (déicsin, déicsen → déicsiu; toimten → toimtiu; léimmen → léimm; luamain, luamon → luam).

transforms.name: n-stem
transforms.description: Oblique cases of the neuter n-stems in -m (léimmen, léimmenaib, léimmim → léimm; neimim → neim; luamain, luamon, luamnaib → luam).

transforms.name: i-stem
transforms.description: Oblique cases of the i-stems in -aid (sercada, sercado, sercadaib → sercaid; búada → búaid).

transforms.name: dental stem
transforms.description: Oblique cases of the abstract nouns in -tu (slántad, slántaid → slántu; treodatad → treodatu).

transforms.name: r-stem
transforms.description: Genitive of the r-stems athair, máthair, bráthair (athar → athair, máthar → máthair).

transforms.name: guttural stem
transforms.description: Oblique cases of the k-stems cathair and nathair (cathrach, cathraig → cathair).

transforms.name: syncope
transforms.description: Case form of a noun whose second syllable lost its vowel before the ending (bríathraib, bríathra → bríathar; samlae → samail; lánamnae → lánamain; féchemna → féchem).

transforms.name: palatal stem
transforms.description: Case form with a palatal final consonant: genitive singular and nominative plural of o-stems, dative and accusative singular of a-stems (fir → fer, maicc → macc, mainn → mann, puirt → port, brataig → bratach).

transforms.name: u-infection
transforms.description: Case form with u-infection: dative singular of o-stems (fiur → fer, purt → port, maull → mall).

transforms.name: accusative plural
transforms.description: Accusative plural of o-stems with raised e (firu → fer, cinnu → cenn).

transforms.name: comparative
transforms.description: Comparative of an adjective (bindiu → bind, ardu → ard, siniu → sen, mailliu → mall).

transforms.name: superlative
transforms.description: Superlative of an adjective (sinem → sen, maillem → mall, láinem → lán).

transforms.name: equative
transforms.description: Equative of an adjective (ardithir → ard, lethidir → lethan).

transforms.name: irregular noun
transforms.description: A case form of an irregular noun (Dé → día, mná → ben, bóu → bó, dóini → duine, coin → cú, ríg → rí, taige → tech, laithe → lá).

transforms.name: spelling
transforms.description: Words written together that dictionaries list apart (intan → in tan).

transforms.name: conjugated preposition
transforms.description: A preposition with a suffixed pronoun or the possessive, read as the preposition (frim "to me" → fri, leis "with him" → la, úaim "from me" → ó, triana "through his" → tri).

transforms.name: function word
transforms.description: A function word in a spelling the dictionary does not list: Middle Irish nocho for nícon "not", cena for cenae "besides", os é "and he", dond "to the", naib for the article, mesi, misi and mise for messe "I", nír for ní with ro, nói for noí "nine", nái for n-aí "of them" (cach nái "each one") or noí.

transforms.name: irregular verb
transforms.description: A form of do·gní "does" the dictionary does not list: the verbal noun dénum, dénam and the passive déntar, dénaiter (dénam → dogní).

transforms.name: spelling
transforms.description: A noun written without the length mark of its headword (liaig → líaig "physician").

transforms.name: emphasising suffix
transforms.description: An emphasising suffix after a hyphen (labrad-sa → labrad, tuit-som → tuit, aní-siu → aní).

transforms.name: spelling
transforms.description: Spelling variant: nd for nn, mm for mb (and back), a single or doubled final c or t, -th for unstressed final -d, -e for -ae (cend → cenn, imb → imm, mac → macc, caraith → caraid, dorche → dorchae).

transforms.name: emphasising suffix
transforms.description: An emphasising suffix on its own, as a hover after the hyphen finds it: its headword has the hyphen (som → -som, sa → -sa).
